g.text: Magnetic Knife Puck v2 — Exploded Stack-up, All Three Mounts
From top (knife) to bottom (wall). Items are shown 2× actual size for clarity. Use puck-drawing.svg for true 1:1 dimensions.
Each puck is Ø18 × 12 mm hardwood + 1 mm leather; magnet is N52 ring 12 × 5 × 4 mm. Use two pucks per knife as the default.
